source: CRESDA/Gaofen published product specifications (GF-1/2/6/7 optical; GF-3 SAR; GF-4 PMI geostationary) and GF-5 AHSI published payload specifications (330-band VNIR/SWIR axis). wavelength_nm prefers the published nominal band centre when documented; otherwise it is the spectral-range midpoint. AHSI per-band centres/FWHM are not stored: they come from each batch's published spectral response table. A range width is never a FWHM.
